name: Really Cool Sparrow
description: The REALLY COOL part is how this Sparrow saves cost, complexity, and mass by ditching the old, outdated method of attaching so-called 'thruster engines' to spaceships in favor of something which provides both propulsion AND defense - guns.
_internalId: Tau's Deeply Stupid Ships/TausDeeplyStupidShips::Really Cool Sparrow

name: Efficiency's Favored Child
description: This ship is an almost entirely custom build - it maintains the exterior form of the Osprey, but is built with Hai technology bringing its durability in line with a Sea Scorpion. It has also had its thrusters ripped out entirely, mount and all to be replaced with rear-facing guns. This brilliant engineering decision allows it to use some of the most efficient engines in the galaxy - Skipper Railguns. Enjoy the savings in outfit space, heat, and energy afforded by 100% all-natural recoil-based thrust.
_internalId: Tau's Deeply Stupid Ships/TausDeeplyStupidShips::Efficiency's Favored Child

name: Merganser Sidestep Special
description: This poor Merganser has been refitted with alien technology and had a crude cannon installed sideways.

name: Broadside
description: This Skein has had its fighter bays converted back into cargo holds, but kept the carrier form. This is to enable use of the ill-advised Boxwing Cannon.

name: Combat Microdrone
description: Combat Microdrones are disposable units meant to be deployed and forgotten. They do not have reactors or shields and only the minimum viable hull plating. This model is equipped with a Gatling Snubnose to deliver high amounts of hull damage in its short lifespan. 	Drones do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a microdrone unless you have a ship in your fleet with a microdrone bay.

name: Arby's
description: The Arby's is a light carrier, shamelessly plagarized from the Lionheart Aerie. Its fighter bays have been modified to house ten microdrones, and its offensive complement reduced to accomodate.

name: Galaga
description: Southbound Shipyards' Fury is a scary little interceptor. The gun ports on this one have been spread for reasons unknown to modern science.

name: Marder Vanguard
description: The Vanguard is Syndicated Systems' crapbucket budget heavy warship. This one has been "improved" by spreading the gun ports outward. It makes a pretty light show, at least.

name: Arby's Double
description: The Arby's Double is a medium carrier, shamelessly plagarized from the Lionheart Aerie and then further mangled with additional bay space. Its fighter bays have been modified to house twenty microdrones, and its offensive complement further reduced to a single turret due to the engineering team claiming it is 'just too dang heavy.'

name: Arby's Half Pound
description: The Arby's Double is a heavy carrier, shamelessly plagarized from the Lionheart Aerie and then further mangled with additional bay space to a silly degree. Its fighter bays have been modified to house four tens of microdrones. Extreme compromises had to be made to hold the thing together. It has been left totally unarmed. This was not a good idea.
_internalId: Tau's Deeply Stupid Ships/TausDeeplyStupidShips::Arby's Half Pound

name: Bactrain
description: The 'Bactrain' is the product of low-oxygen pirate minds, and a lot of welding.

name: Rocket Microdrone
description: Rocket Microdrones are disposable units meant to be deployed and forgotten. They do not have reactors or shields and only the minimum viable hull plating. This model is equipped with a Heavy Rocket Interlock Bypass to further lean into the disposable nature of microdrones. 	Drones do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a microdrone unless you have a ship in your fleet with a microdrone bay.

name: Swarm Falcon
description: The Tarazed Falcon is one of the most powerful warships that civilians can buy. This version has its pontoons modified into microdrone bays at the expense of the turrets which normally reside there. In its standard configuration, this allows it to dish out high shield damage with its Plasma Cannons, then release eight Combat Microdrones to shred the target's hull right quick with their Snubnose Gatlings.

name: Finchdock
description: When even an interceptor is too sluggish, the Finchdock is here provide the bare minimum needed for interstellar transport of a pilot's beloved fighter.

name: Stolsaqra II
description: This experimental design attempts to address the shortcomings of the Stolsaqra by offloading several key systems to a paired vessel. The Stolsaqra II has no hyperdrive, energy generation, or shield generation. It relies on docking with the Aclo-Seiitej for interstellar travel and rapid resupply. This allows for only a short effective runtime, but greatly increased performance during that period relative the earlier Stolsaqra.

name: Aclo-Seiitej
description: This is the other half of the Stolsaqra II Partitioned Interceptor. Its purpose is to transport both vessels between star systems, and provide rapid repair and resupply to the Stolsaqra II. Being an advanced experimental vessel, it has been outfitted with rare Predecessor cloaking technology upon which it must rely as it has no offensive capability on its own.

name: Rav
description: Uncle Trusty thought the Raven was very cool, but would be -even cooler- if the wings weren't so long. So he had them chopped off. Plagued by both energy and heat problems, but sacrifices had to be made for -the aesthetic-

name: Pigeon
description: Okay look. Let's get this out in the open - this was 100% a scaling mistake in CAD. But here it is. Uncle Trusty says it is solid. You can trust him.

name: Katydid
description: Following the success of the Pond Strider ands its Fleas, the Hai hit on new ways to engage in low-risk, time-consuming modes of combat to keep their Unfettered brethren engaged while keeping lethality low. The Katydid is based on the Lightning Bug, trading its Ion Cannon for an array of Skipper Railguns and swaps the Bullfrog Anti-Missiles out to mount a pair of newly-developed Vertical Tracker And Grabber Cluster to aggressively kite individual targets away from the main battle.
